From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Renewal + EU residency and APAC onramp — draft SOW & options

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, I attached a draft SOW that covers the renewal term and two optional tracks for the regional requirements you mentioned: EU data residency with a dedicated EU pool, and a phased APAC onramp for burst capacity and pilot traffic routing.

Quick summary:
- Baseline renewal: 12 months, current hosted plan, standard SLA.
- EU Residency add-on: Dedicated EU capacity (reserved nodes) + data residency contract clause. Estimated delta: +$24k/mo.
- APAC onramp pilot: 3-month pilot with burst-only capacity and cross-region failover tests. Estimated one-time onboarding fee: $12k.

Questions for you to confirm:
1) Do you want a full EU Dedicated pool long-term or a staged model (pilot then scale)?
2) Procurement/Legal contact to include on the amendment?
3) Any required dates for go-live in APAC?

I attached: MedEx_SOW_v2.pdf (draft). If it looks good I can update with pricing table and push to Marissa for discount approval.

Cheers,
Irene

Irene,

- Residency SLA: we need confirmation that EU data at rest and backups remain within EU boundaries. Is that captured in the clause?

Looping procurement for timing. Target for renewal signature is end of February if we can get legal review and SOC2 artifacts.

Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency and APAC onramp — draft SOW & options

Hi Sara / procurement team,

Appreciate the specifics — summarized answers below and attached the updated package.

Residency SLA
- We will include explicit language: physical storage and backups for EU-designated tenants will be provisioned and retained in EU-region AZs. We will provide architecture diagrams and audit logs as evidence.

Failover and billing
- Cross-region failover will route traffic to the nearest available pool. We will surface a latency delta estimate for failover events in the amendment and mark failover traffic as billable at the burst rate (lower than Dedicated sustained rate).
- For predictable economics, we propose a hybrid model: reserved EU capacity for baseline traffic + configured APAC burst capacity with a monthly commit cap.

Pricing options (summary)
- Option A (Conservative): 12-month renewal + EU Residency add-on
  - EU Dedicated pool (baseline): $24,000/mo
  - No APAC commitment; burst billed at $X per 1M tokens
- Option B (Growth): 12-month renewal + EU Dedicated + APAC Pilot
  - EU Dedicated baseline: $22,000/mo (reduced with pilot credit)
  - APAC 3-month pilot onboarding: $12,000 one-time
  - Post-pilot conversion to Dedicated APAC pool negotiable

Attachments: MedEx_SOW_v3.pdf, SOC2-evidence.zip

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement/legal review the SOW and residency clause.
2) If approved, Marissa will confirm commercial discount and I will send a DocuSign amendment.
3) Kickoff and pilot schedule — ideally start APAC pilot on 2027-03-01.
